$description: Rhythm/position/compliance rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule id here has exactly one implementation in schema/semantic_validate.py (verify_all.py checks parity both ways). Severity: error = invalid, warn = non-fatal notice.

rules.description: Cross-references the PageSpec's declared template against THAT template's real node list: every node's (section, variant) must match a template node, in template order, with no repeats of non-repeatable nodes, and every required template node present.

mode and contentProvenance must agree: mode 'reference' <-> contentProvenance 'original-reference'; mode 'generated' <-> 'new-content'. Two fields describe one fact, so a page cannot claim to be generated while keeping the original's provenance (or the reverse).

In mode 'generated' no field may reference a role whose availability is reference-only or blocked-in-generated (the real Flashform logo brand.logo, with any ref), nor a registered asset id whose availability is not generation-safe (asset:logo-flashform, asset:favicon, asset:og-twitter, the original's videos); no text field may mention such an id. In mode 'reference' the real roles stay allowed. The pinned availability of the real logo is enforced by verify_all check 11.

In mode 'generated' the navbar and footer logo must use a generation-safe brand mark role (brandMark: true and availability generation-safe: brand.placeholder, brand.user-supplied or brand.generated-mark), so a generated page never requires the real Flashform trademark.
An original-reference PageSpec must use one of the template's real routes ('/').
Exactly one hero.* node.
rules.exemptionNote: No exemption: the only template requires its hero (templates.json nodes[1].required = true).

rules.description: shell.navbar is the first node.
The hero node immediately follows shell.navbar.
shell.footer is the last node.
If faq.accordion is present it immediately precedes shell.footer.
Counts per section respect constraints.maxPerPage; sections with variantsUniquePerPage may repeat only with distinct variants - keyed on (section, variant), never bare section id.

Two scroll-stage sections (horizontal-scroll pins) should not be adjacent. Observed composition separates them by six sections; this is rhythm guidance derived from that single composition, not a measured breakage, hence warn.
anchorId values are unique on the page.
Every navbar link href '#x' resolves to a node with anchorId x (omitting a section requires removing its link).
A nav link that targets a desktopOnly section (the roadmap is display:none <=1060) must set mobileHidden: true.
Any cta with action 'open-beta-popup' requires overlays.betaPopup.
If the page has a form (footer subscribe or beta popup), overlays.toasts and overlays.submitSpinner=true are required: submitForm always shows the spinner and a toast.
forms.endpoint must never be the original site owner's third-party Formspree endpoint (the clone stubs it: FORM_ENDPOINT = null). Pinned denylist.
In generated-mode pages, footer/legal links must not reuse the original's real contact channels (agency email, a personal WhatsApp number and Telegram handle) or its generated-legal-page tokens.
In generated-mode pages, no text field may equal (case/space-normalised) any original string of 6+ words. The original strings are read from schema/example.pagespec.json (the mode-reference example).
A generated-mode page mentions 'Flashform': fine only when the deployer is the brand owner.
footer physicsWords may only use letters that have a sprite (S,T,A,Y,I,N,O,U,C,H); any other letter would crash TABLE.find in fallingLetters.
Run style 'superscript' (<small class=home-1__h1-small>) exists only in the hero headline.
channelList appears only in panel.rounded-sticky variant 'with-channel-list', and that variant must carry one (on its last item).

assetRef must agree with the role's generationPolicy (assets/asset-roles.json): asset: ids must be registered under that role; generated: only for may-generate-new; owner-supplied: not for must-reuse-exact; registered owner-supplied-only media (the original's videos, screencast, OG image) only in reference-mode pages. A role's allowedRefKinds (assets/asset-roles.json) further restricts the ref kinds.
Every text field respects its section's wordBudgets (sections/*.json content.wordBudgets).

Every node's motion carries the section's reducedMotionFallback. The source only kills CSS transitions under prefers-reduced-motion; JS motion has no reduced-motion branch, so generated pages must declare the static state.
